# agent-resurrect

> Resumes Claude Code sessions in their original iTerm2 panes after a macOS restart, crash or closed window. Each pane that was running a session runs `claude --resume <id>` by itself at its first prompt, in the same folder and permission mode. Today it supports Claude Code in iTerm2 on macOS; other agents and terminals are planned, not shipped. Sessions inside tmux, screen or zellij are not recorded.

Install with one command (`curl -fsSL https://github.com/imgovind/agent-resurrect/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash`), from inside Claude Code (`/plugin marketplace add imgovind/agent-resurrect`, `/plugin install agent-resurrect@agent-resurrect`, then `/agent-resurrect:setup`), or have an agent install it with the prompt in docs/install-with-claude.md. It needs macOS, iTerm2, Claude Code and Python 3.9 or newer, uses no sudo, changes only iTerm2's preferences, the shell rc file and a LaunchAgent, and `agent-resurrect uninstall` reverts every change.

Agents: run it as `~/.local/bin/agent-resurrect`, add `--json`, and branch on the exit code (0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage, 3 not found, 4 needs a terminal, 5 busy, 6 gone). Never use the bare command, `here` or `resume` to start a session: without a terminal they refuse with exit 4; use `--print` and give the command to the user. Refer to sessions by session id, not by list number. In `doctor --json`, run a fix's `argv` only when `agent_may_run` is true.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imgovind/agent-resurrect/main/README.md): what it does, install, commands, troubleshooting, what the installer changes, exit codes and JSON output, FAQ
- [Install with an AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imgovind/agent-resurrect/main/docs/install-with-claude.md): the copy-paste install prompt and what the agent will do
- [Contributing with an AI agent](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/imgovind/agent-resurrect/main/AGENTS.md): layout, test commands, rules, how to add an agent or terminal adapter
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/imgovind/agent-resurrect/tree/main/docs/json): one schema per command's `--json` output

## Commands

- `agent-resurrect ls --json`: sessions that can be resumed, newest first; `--all` adds running ones
- `agent-resurrect find --json "text you remember"`: the session containing that text, and its resume command (never launches)
- `agent-resurrect simulate --assume-restart --json`: what each recorded pane would do after a restart, without launching or changing anything
- `agent-resurrect adopt --json`: record the Claude Code session this command runs under
- `agent-resurrect doctor --json`: every check, with a fix kind and whether an agent may run the fix
- `agent-resurrect install --dry-run --json`: what the installer would change
- `agent-resurrect uninstall --yes`: reverts everything the installer changed
